Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV/MCH), which may be age-related or due to chronic disease. Platelet count is at the upper normal limit, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, suggesting increased platelet size variability, possibly reflecting reactive changes. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation is recommended.
